To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
redox carbon nanomaterials can be easily prepared by nonco-valent functionalization with redox mediators.
redox carbon nanofibers (redox CNFs) can be prepared by the noncovolent functionalization of CNFs with 1, 10-phenanthrolin-5, 6-dione (phenanthrolinquinone).
we developed an electrochemical biosensor based on redox nanomaterials for the detection of NADH and ethanol.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new redox carbon nanomaterial for electrochemical biosensor applications.
the noncovalently functionalization of CNT with a redox molecule, PD.
the noncovalently derived redox carbon nanomaterials for the development of electrochemical biosensors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the redox carbon materials are very promising as the new electrode material for electrochemical biosensor.
noncovalent PD functionalization of CNT can be a promising method to prepare the redox CNT for electrochemical biosensor application.

the noncovalently functionalized PD/CNT/GC electrodes are promising candidates for the fabrication of NADH biosensors and ethanol biosensors with high sensitivity, wide linear range and low detection limit.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PD/CNT/GC electrode can be used as an efficient electrochemical biosensing platform for the determination of NAPDH and ethanol.
PD/CNT/GC could be applied as a promising electrochemical biosensor for the determination of ethanol.
the redox carbon-nanotube modified electrode is a promising candidate for the construction of electrochemical biosensors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PD/CNT/GC exhibits an excellent electrocatalysis towards the oxidation of the biomolecule NADH.
redox carbon nanomaterials prepared by noncovolent functionalization method can be used to fabricate high performance biosensors.
the redox CNT prepared by noncovelent functionalization can be used as a new electrocatalyst and a new matrix for enzyme immobilization.
